label.purpose: Meta text: dates, badges, helper captions.

readout.purpose: Every numeric figure representing real quantities (bags, currency, counts); tabular-nums.

shadows.name: resting-lift
shadows.purpose: Default state for cards and primary buttons — a paper sheet lifted off the desk, not a floating SaaS card.

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: Active/pressed state; paired with translateY(1px) instead of a shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on screen (submit, save, sync retry).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #A3282A; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font: 600 1rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(26,21,18,0.12); transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.08s ease-out, box-shadow 0.08s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7E1E20; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-weight action alongside a primary one (cancel, correct).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #7E1E20; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #D8CFBC; border-radius: 0; font: 600 0.9rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #7E1E20; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: #988878; border-color: #D8CFBC; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bordered field for form entry; focus is a border color shift, no glow ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1512; border: 1.5px solid #D8CFBC; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 1rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #A3282A; } .ds-input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown) { border-color: #A0522D; }

components.name: Entry Card
components.description: One submitted entry in the operator's list, with its readout figures.
components.html:
18 sept. 2026, 09:20

Sacs: 10 · Revenu: 500 · Dépenses: 100
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #D8CFBC; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(26,21,18,0.12); } .ds-card-date { color: #5B5147; font: 600 0.8rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-readout { color: #1A1512; font: 600 1rem ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; }

components.name: Pending Badge (ink stamp)
components.description: Count of entries captured locally but not yet synced, or a draft entry's status — the one rounded, rotated element in the system.
components.css: .ds-badge-pending { background: transparent; color: #7A5C1F; padding: 3px 10px; border: 1.5px solid #7A5C1F; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 0.7rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; transform: rotate(-3deg); display: inline-block; }

components.name: Ledger Table Header
components.description: Table header row for totals/entries tables — uppercase, double-ruled underline like a ledger sum.
components.css: .ds-table th { font: 700 0.8rem system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1A1512; text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 3px double #2A241D; } .ds-numeric { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
Eaglenet reads as a hand-inked account ledger, not a SaaS dashboard: every figure carries the gravity of a bookkeeper's entry, decisively ruled and stamped, the way a cooperative produce-buying society or a bank passbook has recorded transactions for a century. Warm ledger-paper cream sits behind crisp white sheet panels; near-black ink carries the text; one confident accent — a deep bookkeeping-ink red — carries primary actions and every headline total. Structure comes from ruled lines, not soft card chrome: a bold double-rule marks table headers and totals rows the way a ledger book underlines a sum twice before it's final. Corners are sharp, paper-like, never rounded — the one exception is the ink-stamp badge, a rotated oval ring that marks a record's status the way a rubber stamp marks a real document.

This replaces an earlier, more muted system ("The Weigh Station") that read as too quiet and too soft-cornered to feel like an authoritative financial record. This version commits harder: bigger, bolder display type for totals and titles; a real accent color with confidence instead of a desaturated one; visible structural rules instead of implied card boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: One confident Ledger Red accent, reserved for primary actions and headline totals — never decorative, never doubled elsewhere on the same screen.
Warm graphite-black ink on ledger-paper cream, not cool corporate gray-and-blue.
Sharp, ruled component language: zero-radius corners, bold double-rules under totals and table headers, ink-stamp badges for status.
A bold slab-serif display face (Zilla Slab) for titles and headline totals; real numeric data keeps the existing monospace tabular Readout face.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ledger Red appears only on the single most important action or state per screen. If two elements compete for it, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number that represents a real quantity (bags, currency, counts) is set in the Readout face with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Numbers used as ordinary language stay in Body.

rules.name: The Pressable Rule
rules.body: Anything the user taps to commit data (submit, save, sync retry) carries the resting lift at rest and the pressed treatment on :active. Static, non-interactive surfaces stay flat.

dos: Do reserve Ledger Red for exactly one primary action or state per screen.
Do set every real numeric figure in the Readout monospace face with tabular numerals.
Do use the 3px double-rule specifically for totals and table headers — it's a named signal, not decoration.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color alongside Ledger Red.
Don't round any corner except the ink-stamp badge.
Don't set numeric data in the display or body font — it breaks the "mechanical readout" character.
